title: sdks: unify auth & retries, streaming ergonomics, cross-SDK parity fixes, version bump v1.114.0
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: Bring parity across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs for auth/retries and streaming ergonomics, consolidate retry logic behind a single behavior model, and publish a coordinated version bump to v1.114.0 so downstream apps get consistent behavior.

This PR includes: 
- Unify auth handling: centralize token refresh hook so all SDKs have identical behavior for expired keys and token rotation.
- Standardize retry policy: move to a decorrelated retry strategy with idempotency awareness and jitter/backoff parity across SDKs.
- Streaming ergonomics: add incremental async iterator helpers (py: AsyncStreamReader, ts: streamToAsyncIterable helper, go: StreamDecoder) and fix corner cases where connection resets lost buffered tokens.
- Parity fixes: match parameter names, default timeouts, and telemetry tags across sdk implementations.
- Version bump: all three SDKs to v1.114.0 and changelogs updated.

Checklist:
- [x] Python: token refresh hook + AsyncStreamReader + retry strategy implemented and unit tested
- [x] TypeScript: auth middleware unified, stream helper + E2E streaming test
- [x] Go: unified auth retrier, stream decoder + small ergonomic wrapper
- [x] Integration tests across languages pass in CI (some flaky flakiness addressed)
- [x] Changelogs and release notes updated

Notes: The work was split into language-specific commits but kept as a single logical PR to ensure simultaneous release and avoid partial rollouts which caused interoperability problems in prod. See related Linear tickets ENG-2345, ENG-2381. For support escalation reference SUP-987.
